dialogues.speaker: Sulaykha
dialogues.text: There's nothing wrong with loving money as long as you don't hurt anyone in the process of acquiring it, this much I understand.

dialogues.speaker: Sulaykha
dialogues.text: So, hehe, my customers don't need to worry about a thing when shopping here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And you are...

dialogues.speaker: Sulaykha
dialogues.text: I'm not just one of the best wooly blanket sellers, I'm THE best blanket seller.

dialogues.speaker: Sulaykha
dialogues.text: Heh, not only blankets. I will be the top sales, be it toys, jewelry or kitchen wares.

dialogues.speaker: Sulaykha
dialogues.text: ...Oh, but perhaps not books. This is Sumeru, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Sulaykha
dialogues.text: Bye! You're welcome back even if you don't buy anything!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not books?

dialogues.speaker: Sulaykha
dialogues.text: Yep, no books. I'm a law-abiding citizen, so even if smuggling knowledge could make me rich, I still wouldn't touch it with a ten-foot pole.

dialogues.speaker: Sulaykha
dialogues.text: After all, you can't keep making money when you're pushing up daisies.

dialogues.speaker: Sulaykha
dialogues.text: Besides, making money is easy. Even with half my talent, you should still be able to make as much as the Homayanis.

dialogues.speaker: Sulaykha
dialogues.text: Heh, if the Akademiya could have made an argument to get me to enroll that was half as convincing as my own sales pitch, I wouldn't have turned them down on the spot back then.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You are...

dialogues.speaker: Sulaykha
dialogues.text: I'm not just one of the best woolly blanket sellers, I'm *the* best blanket seller, period.

dialogues.speaker: Sulaykha
dialogues.text: And not only do I sell blankets... I am, surely as I live, also the top in sales for toys, jewelry, and kitchen wares.

dialogues.speaker: Sulaykha
dialogues.text: ...Oh, but perhaps not books.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not books?

dialogues.speaker: Sulaykha
dialogues.text: Eh, books are just a non-starter. With Akasha's shutdown, the Akademiya is sure to revise the way they manage books.

dialogues.speaker: Sulaykha
dialogues.text: Not like I ever like those things anyway, so nope, those waters are not for me. I'll just stick to the basics.

dialogues.speaker: Sulaykha
dialogues.text: Besides, making Mora is easy. Even with half my talent, you should still be able to make as much as the Homayanis.

dialogues.speaker: Sulaykha
dialogues.text: Heh, if the Akademiya could have made an argument to get me to enroll that was half as convincing as my sales pitches back then, I wouldn't have turned them down on the spot.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Duel

dialogues.speaker: Sulaykha
dialogues.text: Whoa, you're probably the strongest player I've ever seen...

dialogues.speaker: Sulaykha
dialogues.text: I won, hehe... I feel I should be selling something related to Genius Invokation TCG!
